_note: Component DEFINITIONS only — what a thing is. How it is made lives in recipes.json, because production needs a building, power and labour, not just inputs. producibleLocally=false means the settlement depends on outside supply; read componentChain.js and the README's 'one thread to be careful with' before changing any of these. reserve is the stock a recipe building keeps on hand: with nothing pinned, it makes whatever is furthest below reserve and idles once everything is at it; reservePriority (default 1) weights that shortfall, so the life-support stocks — fuel for the generator, carbon for the scrubbers — win a tie with steel (componentChain.js).

components.name: Steel billet
components.description: Iron ore and coal, smelted into bars, or scrap melted back down at the recycler. The workshop cuts it into basic parts.

quote.text: Steel doesn't care who's Mayor. That's what I like about it.

components.name: Copper wire
components.description: Drawn from copper ore at the smelter. Carries power between junctions and goes into every electrical component.

quote.text: Measured in kilometres. Stolen by the metre.

components.name: Precision contacts
components.description: Gold and silver refined into contacts that never corrode. Delicate machine-shop work, and the heart of every component worth having.

quote.text: Handle by the edges. Breathe somewhere else.

components.name: Fuel
components.description: Coked coal for the main generator. When it runs out, so do the lights.

quote.text: The generator eats first. Then the people. That isn't policy, it's physics.

components.name: Activated carbon
components.description: Baked in the same oven as fuel. Filters the water at the purifier and the air at the scrubbers.

quote.text: The black stuff that makes the other stuff less black.

components._note: Scrubber filter media, and the reason Air depends permanently on Mechanical.

components.name: Concrete
components.description: Limestone burnt with coal and mixed. Floors, walls and new rooms; a storehouse is mostly concrete holding more concrete.

quote.text: Concrete is just rock that has been told what shape to be.

components.name: Glass
components.description: Silica sand melted at the smelter. Grow-light panes for the bays, gauges for the cisterns, and the lenses in precision work.

quote.text: The only thing in the Shaft you can see straight through. Unlike the Board.

components.name: Basic parts
components.description: Bolts, brackets, bearings and gaskets, cut from steel at the workshop. Nearly every repair and every new room needs some.

quote.text: There is no problem in this Shaft that enough basic parts can't solve. There are never enough basic parts.

components.name: Electrical components
components.description: Relays, switches and coils from copper wire and precision contacts. The grid, the lifts and the lighting can't be kept without them.

quote.text: If it hums, it's working. If it clicks, it's thinking. If it smells, run.

components.name: Precision components
components.description: The Shaft's finest work: contacts and glass assembled in the machine shop. Terminals, sensors and clinic equipment rely on it, and it is always the bottleneck.

quote.text: A week to make. One clumsy second to ruin.

components.character: Slow to produce; always the crisis bottleneck

components.name: Scrubber catalyst
components.description: Keeps the scrubbers scrubbing. Nobody in the Shaft makes it; it comes down through the Exit, from the founders' stockpiles.

quote.text: Founders' stock. I asked how much is left and they gave me a form.

components._note: NO RECIPE EXISTS IN recipes.json, and that absence is the point — expressing the gap by omission rather than a boolean is harder to break by accident. Players will notice they never mine it; the Chapter 2 demonstration pays off a detail they have been staring at for twenty hours. Changing this is a narrative decision, not a balance tweak.
